name: Automated Multi-Position CV Screening with AI Candidate Analysis

parameters.content:
## Multi-Position Automated CV Scanner & Screening Intelligence

This workflow powers automated enterprise hiring across **8 target positions**:
1. **Collects** candidate applications via a responsive web form or `/api/cv/screen` API endpoint.
2. **Extracts** high-fidelity text from resumes (PDF/TXT) using **Mistral OCR**.
3. **Dynamically Analyzes** candidate CVs against target role rubrics using **Gemini 2.5 Flash**.
4. **Stores** multi-role evaluations (`qualificationRate`, `status`, `targetRole`, `coreChecks`, `explanation`) in Google Sheets & Postgres.
5. **Dispatches** position-tailored follow-up communications.

*Supported Roles*:
• Senior Frontend Dev (React/TS)
• Senior Backend Engineer (Python/FastAPI)
• Fullstack Security Engineer (AppSec)
• Real-Time WebRTC Architect (WSS)
• DevOps & Cloud Infrastructure (K8s/CI-CD)
• AI & Machine Learning Engineer (LLMs/RAG)
• UI/UX Product Designer (Design Systems)
• Mobile App Engineer (Flutter/React Native)

parameters.text:
=<goal>
Evaluate candidate CV against the selected Target Position criteria. Produce structured JSON output containing qualificationRate (0.0 to 1.0), status (Qualified >= 0.75, Borderline 0.55-0.74, Unqualified < 0.55), core_checks, preferred_checks, and a detailed justification citing evidence from the CV.
</goal>

<candidate_submission>
Candidate Name: {{ $('Application Form').last().json['Full Name'] }}
Candidate Email: {{ $('Application Form').last().json['Email'] }}
Target Position: {{ $('Application Form').last().json['Target Position'] || 'Senior Frontend Developer (React/TS)' }}

CV Text Extracted by OCR:
{{ $json.text || $json.body || $('Extract CV Text (Mistral OCR)').last().json.text }}
</candidate_submission>

<position_rubrics>
1. Senior Frontend Developer (React/TS):
   - Core: 5+ Years Frontend Experience, Project Leadership, JavaScript/TypeScript, React Framework, State Management (Redux/Zustand), Modern Styling (Tailwind/CSS-in-JS), API Integration (REST/GraphQL), Testing (Jest/RTL), Git/Version Control, Communication.
   - Preferred: Next.js/Remix, Node.js/APIs, CI/CD, Figma/Design Acumen, Performance/Core Web Vitals.

2. Senior Backend Engineer (Python/FastAPI/Distributed Systems):
   - Core: 4+ Years Backend Experience, Python & Asyncio, FastAPI/Django, Databases (PostgreSQL/Redis), API Architecture (REST/WebSockets), Microservices & Concurrency, Data Integrity & ACID, Testing (Pytest), Git/CI-CD, Documentation.
   - Preferred: Message Queues (Kafka/RabbitMQ), Docker/Kubernetes, Cloud (AWS/GCP), Security/Auth (JWT/OAuth2), Prometheus/Telemetry.

3. Fullstack Security Engineer (FastAPI/React/AppSec):
   - Core: 3+ Years Fullstack Experience, Frontend (React/TS), Backend (Python/Node), Auth & RBAC (OAuth2/JWT), OWASP Top 10 Mitigation, Cryptography & TLS 1.3, API Security & Rate Limiting, SAST/DAST Testing, Git & Secure CI/CD, Incident Response.
   - Preferred: CTF/Penetration Testing, Cloud IAM Governance, Stream Protection (WSS/WebRTC), SOC2/ISO27001, Zero Trust Architecture.

4. Real-Time Systems & WebRTC Architect (WSS/Voice-Video):
   - Core: 4+ Years Real-Time Experience, WebRTC PeerConnections/SDP/ICE, WebSocket Architecture, Network Protocols (UDP/TCP/QUIC), Async Concurrency, Audio/Video Codecs (Opus/H.264), State Sync & Presence, Network Drop Resilience, Git, Documentation.
   - Preferred: SFU/MCU (Mediasoup/LiveKit/Pion), WebAssembly DSP, Distributed Redis Clusters, Mobile WebRTC, Low-Latency Anycast.

5. DevOps & Cloud Infrastructure Engineer (K8s/Cloudflare/CI-CD):
   - Core: 4+ Years DevOps/SRE, Linux Administration & Shell, Docker Containers, Kubernetes Orchestration, Terraform/Ansible IaC, CI/CD Automation (GitHub Actions), Cloud Platforms (AWS/GCP/Cloudflare), Monitoring (Prometheus/Grafana), GitOps, SLA/Post-Mortems.
   - Preferred: Blue/Green Deployments, Service Mesh (Istio), Cloudflare Tunnels/Workers, CIS Hardening, FinOps.

6. AI & Machine Learning Engineer (LLMs/Agents/Vector RAG):
   - Core: 3+ Years AI/ML Experience, Python/PyTorch, LLM Integration & Prompt Engineering (Gemini/OpenAI), Vector DBs & RAG (Pinecone/Milvus), Agentic Workflows & Tool Calling, OCR & Multimodal Extraction, Scalable APIs (FastAPI/vLLM), Evaluation Metrics, MLOps, Documentation.
   - Preferred: Fine-Tuning/LoRA, Multi-Agent Swarms (AGY SDK/CrewAI), Quantization (GGUF), Knowledge Graphs, Edge AI.

7. UI/UX Product Designer & Motion Architect:
   - Core: 3+ Years Product Design, Figma & Design Systems, User Research & User Flows, Visual Hierarchy & Typography, Interactive Motion & Prototyping, Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA), HTML/CSS Collaboration, Responsive Layouts, DesignOps, Portfolio Rationales.
   - Preferred: 3D Spatial UI (Spline/Three.js), Micro-Interactions (Framer Motion), A/B Testing, Custom Iconography, Design Mentorship.

8. Mobile Application Engineer (Flutter/React Native/iOS):
   - Core: 3+ Years Mobile Development, Cross-Platform (Flutter/React Native), State Management & Offline Caching, Native iOS/Android Tooling (Xcode/Gradle), Real-Time API Integration, 60fps Mobile Animations, Mobile Testing, App/Play Store Deployment, Mobile CI/CD, Documentation.
   - Preferred: Push Notifications (FCM/APNs), Mobile VoIP/WebRTC (CallKit), Biometric Security, Deep Linking, Profiling (Memory/FPS).
</position_rubrics>

<evaluation_rules>
- If all core requirements for the candidate's target position are satisfied, base score is >= 0.75.
- Preferred criteria add bonuses up to 1.0.
- If any core requirement is missing, score cannot exceed 0.60.
- Provide an unambiguous evidence explanation detailing which criteria were met or missing.
</evaluation_rules>
